meta.note: Power: Deconstruction (cooldown 180). Not expressed as modifiers: Time Shift of own buildings (major_gods.xml timeshifting, see power 'time-shift'); lost siege weapons (wood, gold) and myth units (all resources incl. favor) refund 20% (ResourceReturnRate 0.20; not Promethean Offspring).
